nom: QUIA Toner Pads for Sensitive Skin

avis.titre: Disappointed due to break out on my normal skin.
avis.texte: I seen no changes after a few uses. I do not have sensitive skin. I have normal skin and have used many different products from a variety of brands and never have I broken out in the 40 plus years. This is the first product I have ever used that claims its been tested to work for even sensitive skin (which i don't have sensitive skin, I have normal skin), and have broken out. I am very disappointed.

I’ve been using these QUIA toner pads for a few weeks now and I’m honestly impressed! The pads feel super soft on the skin and don’t cause irritation at all. I noticed my pores looking smaller and my skin texture becoming smoother after consistent use. They leave my face feeling fresh, hydrated, and clean without drying it out. I also love that the pads are pre-soaked with just the right amount of product, making them very convenient for daily skincare. The calming formula works great for sensitive skin, and I’ve seen a visible reduction in blackheads and small blemishes. Definitely worth the purchase if you want an easy Korean skincare product that actually gives results! 💚

avis.titre: My skin feels smoother, my pores look smaller, easy to use, and I have zero complaints.
avis.texte: I’ve absolutely loved the QUIA No More Pore Pads! They’ve become one of my favorite skincare products. My skin feels smoother, looks clearer, and my pores appear more refined with consistent use. They’re gentle enough for my skin but still leave me feeling like I’m getting a deep clean every time. I also love how easy they are to use and how fresh my face feels afterward. I honestly have zero complaints. Everything from the results to the overall experience has exceeded my expectations. I will definitely be repurchasing and highly recommend them to anyone looking to improve the look of their pores and skin texture!
Very disappointing quality. The pads felt rough on my skin and didn’t deliver the results I expected. They dried out quickly and weren’t worth the money. I wouldn’t buy them again.
One of the best toner ever!! I highly recommend that if you have large pores.
Great! I’ve already purchased it more than once. Does wonders on the skin

avis.titre: Effective and Gentle, Minor Packaging Issue
avis.texte: These toner pads from QUIA are very effective yet gentle on sensitive skin. The AHA/BHA formula exfoliates while hydrating, helping reduce blackheads, texture, and dark spots without irritation. The pads are soft, well-soaked, and soothing, making them easy to use daily. However, the product packaging arrived slightly damp, which did not affect the pads or performance but is worth noting. Overall, a great all-in-one skincare product with excellent results.

I’m honestly impressed with these toner pads, they’ve become a staple in my skincare routine. I have sensitive skin, so I’m usually cautious with exfoliating products, but these are incredibly gentle while still delivering noticeable results. There’s no stinging or burning at all, just a fresh, clean feeling after each use. I noticed my skin felt smoother and more hydrated almost immediately, and after about a week my pores looked smaller and less congested, especially around my nose and T zone. The dual sided pads are such a smart design. The textured side exfoliates without being harsh, and the smooth side is perfect for soothing and hydrating more sensitive areas like my cheeks. One of my favorite things is how saturated these pads are. They’re not flimsy or dry at all. Each one is fully soaked with essence and feels luxurious on the skin. The pads themselves are thick, soft, and don’t tear, which makes application easy and mess free. The included tweezers are a nice hygienic touch too. Overall, this feels like a high quality, dermatologist level product that actually does what it claims. My skin looks clearer, more even, and healthier without irritation. If you’re dealing with pores, blackheads, or texture, especially with sensitive skin. I highly recommend giving these a try.

avis.titre: Some Good KBeauty Pads That Seem To Deliver On Their Advertisements And Statements
avis.texte: As someone who has always struggled with highly visible pores, blackheads, inflamed hair follicles, and very oily yet dry skin, I thought that this would be worth a try to see if it could help. I've tried most of the US-based name brands without a whole lot of luck, so I figured "why not?". The first thing that I noticed unpacking these is that the packaging is very nice. It's pleasant coloring and materials. The container for the wipes is really top notch - it includes a secondary seal to place over the wipes to help keep them from drying out. It also included a little clear set of tweezers to get the wipes out of the jar so I'm not digging in there with my finger and contaminating them. I felt like that was pretty thoughtful. When I removed the safety seal and the 2nd seal, I discovered that they aren't lying - they really are pretty drenched in the solution the pads are soaked in. That 2nd seal should help keep that being the case. There are a couple of drying/potential irritation agents in these like salicylic acid and lactic acid, so I was curious to see if they'd dry my skin out further at all, but it appears there are also enough offsetting ingredients in here to keep that from happening. The wipes removed an extraordinary amount of oil and dirt from my face - I really didn't like thinking that was all on there, but that also means they are absolutely doing their job. I also did feel like maybe it did tighten up/close my pores a little bit. I didn't experience any burn

The box was moist and mildewy. I went to open it and there was black mold and a putrid smell! The manufacturer needs to pay closer attention to how they store items. Especially items that go on someone’s face.

avis.titre: Helps me with clogged pores and oily skin.
avis.texte: The Quia Toner Pads are great for me because I am always on the go, and they are super easy to apply at home, or even take them with me when I feel that my skin may break out. They cool and hydrate my skin with just one pad, and I can see them working effectively right away and getting rid of any excess oil. I do have sensitive skin, so I have to balance and pay attention when using them so that my skin is not too dry or too oily. And for that reason, quite often it is better to just use one pad a day, and perhaps on some days skip them altogether to keep that balance. Overall, I like that they do not have negative effects on my skin. When I feel my skin feeling irritated, this is what I go to first to help prevent a breakout, and it does help a lot. These pads help hydrate my skin while at the same time helping me with clogged pores. I do see a difference with smoother and more vibrant skin as well. For what I got, this is a great overall value.

I think someone got confused somewhere along the way with this product. Per the ingredients list, these pads include lactic acid (AHA) and salicylic acid (BHA). They do not include PHA. I'm a regular user of salicylic acid, so I'm ok with this, it's just misleading and makes me question the product and even the brand as a whole. Despite the error, I have been using these pads and they are effective as a gentle chemical exfoliant. The pads are textured on one side and smooth on the other. Both sides are soft and not abrasive at all. They are a generous size and you can use them as a quick treatment by just leaving them on your skin like a mask for a few minutes. The pads come saturated and I don't see them drying out before I get thru them. They don't have a strong scent, but they do have a bit of a smell from the various oil extracts and eucalyptus in them. These pads seem a bit pricey to me. I've used other brands that I've had good results from for roughly half the cost of these. Even though I like them and they are working well enough, given the cost and the huge difference in the ingredients between the product info and what I received, I probably wouldn't reorder these. I received these in Jan 2026 and they have an expiration of Nov 2028. avis.titre: Great for exfoliating and smoothing skin
avis.texte: Love the design of this product! From the sturdy screw off top to the tweezers that come included to keep the pads sanitary and fresh, to the light and clean fragrance that pleasantly surprised me. The jar is well made while being sleek and a beautiful shade of pale green. The skin feel is out of this world immediately makes your skin smoother/softer while getting rid of any flaking or peeling you may have. Great for people with normal or sensitive skin, I've had zero issues with redness or any kind of purging.

This container has 70, 2in1 cleansing pads. One side of the pad is embossed, and the other is smooth so you can exfoliate and hydrate your skin. The pads are thin but effective and are soaked very well. One pad covers my entire face and neck area. The container is a good size and comes with a set of plastic tweezers to grab a cleansing pad. I have been using these for a few days now and my face feels clean and smooth after using. Its great there has been no skin irritation. A good value for the price.

avis.titre: Excellent toner pads with a great formula
avis.texte: These are excellent toner pads! They do the job of exfoliating, pore clearing, and hydrating all at the same time. The salicylic acid clears the gunk out of your pores, and the lactic acid helps smooth and brighten the skin. The glycerin and hyaluronate then hydrate the skin so it looks moist. The natural oils are antimicrobial, and the B5 then strengthens the skin barrier. This is a great combination of ingredients in a simple, easy-to-use pad. The pads are plentifully stocked in the jar, and they are amply moist. They hold up well as you use them, and they don't leave an oily residue on your face. Overall, they make for an excellent Korean skin care product.

Upon opening my package, I noticed that the box that my product came in was a little soggy and smelled musty. Before purchasing I read a review stating that another customer had the same issue, but that it didn’t affect the product, so I didn’t think anything of it. Boy was I wrong! The inside of the box was full of MOLD! Will be returning ASAP.

avis.titre: Porque tiene que llegar en esa condición
avis.texte: La caja está rota y húmeda El líquido que trae el envase se salió todo

These toner pads are super gentle but still do the job. No burning, no redness, just clean, smooth skin. They’ve helped with little blackheads around my nose and don’t dry me out at all. I love that they exfoliate and hydrate in one step, especially on lazy skincare nights. My skin feels calm and soft afterward, not tight. If you have sensitive skin and want something simple that actually works, these are a great buy. They are pricey, but you get what you pay for and when it comes to my skin, I don't go cheap!

avis.titre: Results yes, but not instant results
avis.texte: I have been using these toner pads daily for almost two weeks now and I have seen a gradual improvement over that time. It wasn't instant results for me, but I have seen visible improvements in my pores and the smoothness of my skin. I like that the pads are adequately moist and not dried out at all. Similar pads that I've used before sometimes required two because they were not moist enough, but that has not been an issue with these. I like that the container had such a good, tight seal on it. I have sensitive skin and other than a couple small pimples (that I don't usually get), I have not experienced any irritation in using them. To me, they have a very light smell to them that just seems like the ingredients that are in them, not from some mystery fragrance. The directions refer to a dual side and how to use them, but to me the textured side is hardly distinguishable from the smooth side and I'll get the same results if I just use them as I typically would.

I’m new to toner pads, and I was pleasantly surprised by how practical and easy these are to use. I have dry skin, and I used one right after cleansing. My skin felt instantly hydrated, and my pores looked more refined. I also really appreciate that the pads come in a sealed container and include a spatula, which makes them more hygienic and convenient.

avis.titre: Ingredients list needs to be on the product page
avis.texte: I'm disappointed in these Ouia toner pads, because upon receiving them, I spotted an ingredient that my skin is highly allergic to as one of the top ingredients, 1, 2 Hexanediol. It gives me hives, followed by several days of dry, sensitive skin that can't even tolerate the normal products I use after using a product containing this ingredient. If the manufacturer had simply listed the ingredients, then I could have avoided ordering this product. I also noticed a couple of other ingredients that are potential triggers for others with allergies. I'm not sure how this is being marketed as being good for sensitive skin. For people who do not have any issues with questionable ingredients, my observations are: -The pads have no scent. -They are nice and wet with product. -The actual pad has the back side with a more coarse, exfoliating texture, and the front of the pad is made of soft cotton. I have pads from another company that are similar to these, and I really love the dual function of these. Basically, the back side gets used first, and it cleans away dead skin, leftover particles, or makeup, and anything else that shouldn't be there. Then, after wiping the face well with the exfoliating side, turn the pad over and wipe the soft side all over. It makes the skin very clean, and it's also really soothing. -The packaging is of nice quality. At the time of this review, the price is $39.99 for a pack of 70 pads. If used once a day, then it's a supply for more than two months. That

When this came, there was a visible mold spot on the outside of the packaging and it was WET, even though it was “sealed” in the plastic wrap still. Then on the inside of the packaging, MORE MOLD covering the inside around the product. As a skincare item, this is unacceptable.

Product description is promising, though I haven't had a chance to try it. Received damaged. Box came all wet, falling apart. The jar inside was all wet, seal was not properly done, so leaked. Pads looked dry. Unfortunately returning. Might try ordering again.
Just opened package and Quia box had been opened before. Wrapping torn. Item dirty and box damaged. Product may be good, but it came damaged. Returning it.
Horrible!! Tenía mucha expectativa con este producto y así fue como lo recibí, pésimo…

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliation at a high cost
avis.texte: This is the kind of toner that makes sense to me! Pads soaked with toner, rather than a liquid that tells you to just pat into your skin for exfoliation; how is that supposed to work? This product is scent free with dual sided pads that hold plenty of liquid. They are thick, soft and, thankfully, haven’t irritated my sensitive skin. I love how gentle the pads are in comparison to my usual cotton rounds and how the soothing formula makes my skin feel though I haven’t noticed any of the “visible pore refinement” specified in the listing. They are quite expensive for me at $39.99 for what amounts to a 70-day supply (35 if used twice a day), so I will likely not ne purchasing in the future, but I would recommend these toner pads if breaking your budget isn’t an issue.

QUIA Toner Pads – PHA Dual-Action Exfoliate and Hydrate All in One – Soothing Formula for Sensitive Skin – Reduces Blackheads and Blemishes- 70 Gentle Textured Pads – Korean Skincare. I have oily skin & live in a tropical climate, so I ordered these. These are definitely marketed for a premium experience. The jar is tightly secured, with a nicer-than-usual pair of tweezers enclosed. The toner pad is dual sided which I always appreciate. I've used many types of toner pads, mostly K-beauty ones, and really like these. These are both refreshing & soothing. Many times my skin feels tacky or sticky from the toner: this does not happen with this brand. I'm also a skeptic, so I usually don't notice any effects until a lot of time has passed. So for now, this is a very solid 4 stars.

Received these QUIA toner pads and I love the fact that they're multifunctional. These toner pads were sealed nicely and soaked in the serum they come in. Each pad is generously coated so you get enough product per application. Product comes with some small tongs so your hands don't have to do the digging. Toner pads seems to be gentle and very hydrating. I didn't have any allergic reaction to them. They have a slight medicinal smell to them but its not bothersome at all. Price seems high at $39.99 but if you think about it, that's 2+ months worth if used daily. So I think its a fair price for the dual action.

avis.titre: Smoothing results quickly but also quite drying
avis.texte: These PHA toner pads are double-sided with an exfoliating side to be used first, followed by the embossed, gentle side. After a couple nights of consecutive use, my face looked especially smooth but also felt quite dry, despite following the toner pads with moisturizer, as directed. I had started with once-daily use, though the directions call for twice-daily use. I'd like to build up to that frequency, if possible, but I need to start with once-every-other-night use and drench my face with moisture afterward.
